name: Roofing Template 1
design_style: Storm-tough trust. Graphite/charcoal base with a confident storm-red CTA and warm sand neutrals. Signature interactive before/after roof slider.
best_for: Residential roofers in a storm/hail belt (TX, OK, CO, the Midwest) who win on storm-damage replacements and insurance-claim help and need to look established and trustworthy.
demo_brand: Ridgeline Roofing (Dallas-Fort Worth), placeholder identity, swap per client
sections: hero (split copy + roofer image, float rating card + warranty badge)
signature: before/after roof slider (drag to compare)
signature_features: Interactive before/after roof slider (pointer + keyboard via range input)
Insurance-claim help positioned as a first-class service (storm-belt money angle)
4-step process section (inspection → estimate & insurance → install → walkthrough)
FAQ accordion (one open at a time, aria-expanded)
motion: Minimum-animation build per brief. Vanilla JS only, IntersectionObserver scroll-reveal, hide-on-scroll header, FAQ accordion, and the user-driven before/after slider. NO perpetual background loops (no beams/sheen/auto-rotation/pulsing). Every animation honors prefers-reduced-motion.

delivery.format: single-file index.html, no local asset dependencies
delivery.remote_images: Pexels, hero (33404248 roofer), why/crew (33404981 DFW brick home), before (37677476 tear-off), after (33404080 new shingles). Swap all for the client's real job photos.
delivery.logo: inline SVG roof-line mark (no raster file required)
